name: chrome
description: Control Chrome by importing the plugin Browser Client into Anybox's general-purpose Node REPL.

shortDescription.en-US: Use Chrome through a persistent Node REPL.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过持久 Node REPL 使用 Chrome。

longDescription.en-US: A Chrome plugin whose Browser Client is imported by the agent into Anybox's general-purpose Node REPL on first use. Browser requests return to the Anybox Agent through a controlled host-service bridge, while the plugin bundles the Chrome extension and platform-specific Rust Native Messaging Host.
longDescription.zh-CN: 一个由 Agent 在首次使用时把 Browser Client 导入 Anybox 通用 Node REPL 的 Chrome 插件。浏览器请求通过受控宿主服务桥回到 Anybox Agent，插件自身仅携带 Chrome 扩展和平台对应的 Rust Native Messaging Host。

permissions: Reads and controls Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension, including navigation, page inspection, screenshots, clicks, scrolling, typing, and form filling.
Uses a versioned Browser Contract and backend capabilities; the Anybox Agent revalidates every browser command before forwarding it.

Raw page JavaScript, selector-driven click/fill adapters, and Chrome DevTools Protocol commands are disabled at both the Browser Contract and Anybox Agent command boundaries; bounded selector waits remain available.
Registers and runs the plugin-bundled Native Messaging Host for the current user.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be installed, enabled, and connected.
connectorRequirements.reason: The agent imports this plugin's Browser Client into Anybox's persistent general-purpose Node REPL.

skillPreviews.name: Chrome
skillPreviews.description: Control the user's Chrome browser through a persistent Node REPL when tasks depend on existing tabs, signed-in sessions, extensions, visible page state, or UI interaction.
